visualCharacteristics.purpose: Dark full-bleed band with a background video (link in the text) and a large centered statement paragraph
visualCharacteristics.summary: Black full-bleed band with background video, large centered white statement paragraph, decorative diagonal stripes bottom right

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = optional background image (UE fields image + imageAlt), used as fallback; row 2 = rich text (UE field text) with the statement paragraph and a paragraph containing a link to the background video (Vimeo, YouTube or .mp4). The link is removed from view and replaced by a muted, autoplaying, looping background video
contentPattern.source: get_block_details /block-collection/hero and blocks/hero/_hero.json (model fields image, imageAlt, text)

cells: Block name plus variant, e.g. Hero (video)
Rich text (field text): heading or statement, subheading, CTA link; the background-video URL as a link for the video variants

usage: Mid-page brand statement band over video.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single centered statement over video; the video link is removed from view and turned into the background.
